text:
sylvia: Quick heads-up — planning a small EU 'heatstep' canary in ~20m (change window 17:00-18:00 UTC). Rolling model 3.2.1 -> 3.2.2, target slice 8% traffic to start. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/3.2.2 :eyes:
jamie: Thanks — I can monitor dashboards and tracing during the window.
mike: Can we pin 3.2.1 as the immediate fallback before the roll? Want the pin in place to make rollback deterministic.
sylvia: Yes, we'll pin fallback version and enable fast rollback path. Deploy bot will show the operations.
ops_ana: I'll watch error budget + embedding latency. Will report any >5% relative change on 95p.
sylvia: Deploy command queued: `redwoodctl deploy start --model=llama-7b-quant --from=3.2.1 --to=3.2.2 --slice=8% --region=eu`
deploy-bot: [deploy] Job 9012 queued by sylvia. Change-window verified. Starting at 5101234585.
deploy-bot: [deploy] Traffic shift: 2% -> 8% / model=3.2.2 / region=eu-west1
jamie: FYI traces show a slight tail increase for generation tokens at ~1.2s extra on some rps.
ops_ana: Observability: 95p latency +18% vs baseline (last 10m), p50 unchanged. Error rate for generations +0.5ppt. Error budget burn 0.7% in last 5m.
mike: Seeing a few embed timeouts from the new model variant (connection resets). Not widespread but correlated to requests with long prompts.
jamie: Correlation to KV-cache warmup? a few host OOMs on a node reported by infra-monitoring.
sylvia: Ok — call for quick check: do we continue to ramp or abort and rollback? Vote (y/n).
jamie: n — prefer abort, want deeper trace + crash logs.
mike: n — pin/fallback now.
ops_ana: n — based on error budget trajectory.
sylvia: Vote tally: 0/4 go. Aborting rollout and initiating rollback to 3.2.1. Pinning fallback.
sylvia: Rollback command: `redwoodctl deploy rollback --to=3.2.1 --force-pin --reason="eu latency + embed timeouts"`
deploy-bot: [deploy] Rollback initiated by sylvia. Reverting traffic to pinned version 3.2.1.
deploy-bot: [deploy] Traffic now 100% -> model=3.2.1 across EU regions. Canary aborted.
jamie: Confirming metrics returning to baseline (+/- noise). No further OOM alerts after drain.
mike: Filing a short issue: model tokenization edge-case causing longer decoding; will add regression test and a small input-preprocess guard.
ops_ana: I'll produce a quick post-deploy snapshot and add it to the incident notes.
sylvia: Thanks all. Action items: mike -> PR for tokenization guard; infra -> investigate OOMs and KV-cache warmup; eng-qa -> add a perf regression test to the eval harness. I'll schedule a re-roll in next change window after fixes.
jamie: :thumbsup: good catch.
sylvia: I'll write a short rollout note in the release thread and label it 'aborted-heatstep' so we don't re-run by accident.
deploy-bot: [note] Rollout aborted and rolled back. Logs: https://internal.redwood/logs/9012
sylvia: End of thread — filing follow-up and linking to postmortem.
